title: Deliver Iron Ore to Prinnton Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Prinnton Steel Mill** (industry id 6, near tile 85,45).

A likely supplier is **Frendingstone Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 69,55); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **380 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
